body.name: Fixed-Bonferroni bias-plus-standard-error SOCP
body.construction: For \(s\in\{\mathrm{nested},\mathrm{deep}\}\), solve \(\Gamma_s=\min_{w,u,v,g}g\) subject to \(w\in\mathcal F_s\), \(\lVert x_j-\sum_iw_{jh,i}x_i\rVert_2\le u_{jh}\), \(\lVert R_Qa_{jh}(w)\rVert_2\le v_{jh}\), and \(Lu_{jh}+\delta+z_Bv_{jh}\le g\) for every \((j,h)\in\mathcal E\).
